_comment: One template family per RELATION, never per fact. A fact is rendered into questions only by substituting
its subject into these strings — no question is ever hand-written or hand-tuned for a particular fact,
which is what stops the question set from being quietly shaped around what the patch happens to know.
Each family has exactly three surface forms:
P  the canonical, terse phrasing. This form — and ONLY this form — becomes a {prompt, answer} training
row. Scored and reported as the memorisation ceiling, never as the headline.
E1 a different English wording of the same question. Never trained on. THE HEADLINE BUCKET.
E2 the same question in Korean. Never trained on. Measures cross-lingual transfer of the compiled fact.
`answer_type` is fixed here, per relation, before any model sees any question (bench/questions/schema.json).
`direction` documents which way the lookup runs: 'forward' is subject -> attribute, 'reverse' is
attribute -> subject. Reverse and partial lookups are cheap to remember and awkward to query, so the
summary reports them as their own cut.

vault_symbol.P: What is the token symbol of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_symbol.E1: A vault is deployed at {subject} on Ethereum. Which ticker does its share token trade under?
vault_symbol.E2: 이더리움의 {subject} 주소에 있는 ERC-4626 볼트의 토큰 심볼은 무엇입니까?

vault_name.P: What is the name of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_name.E1: The contract {subject} is a tokenized vault. What is it called?

vault_address.P: What is the contract address of the ERC-4626 vault {subject}?
vault_address.E1: Where is the {subject} vault deployed on Ethereum mainnet?
vault_address.E2: {subject} 볼트의 이더리움 메인넷 컨트랙트 주소는 무엇입니까?

vault_asset.P: What is the underlying asset address of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_asset.E1: Which token does the vault at {subject} accept as its deposit asset? Give the token address.
vault_asset.E2: {subject} 볼트가 예치 자산으로 받는 토큰의 주소는 무엇입니까?

vault_asset_symbol.P: What is the underlying asset symbol of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_asset_symbol.E1: Depositors into the vault at {subject} deposit which token? Give the ticker.

vault_tvl_usd.P: What is the total value locked in USD of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_tvl_usd.E1: How many US dollars of assets does the vault at {subject} hold?
vault_tvl_usd.E2: {subject} 볼트에 예치된 총 자산은 미국 달러로 얼마입니까?

market_asset_symbol.P: What is the input token symbol of the lending market at {subject}?
market_asset_symbol.E1: Which asset is borrowed and supplied in the lending market at {subject}? Give the ticker.
market_asset_symbol.E2: {subject} 대출 마켓의 기초 자산 티커는 무엇입니까?

market_address.P: What is the address of the {subject} lending market?
market_address.E1: Where is the lending market for {subject} deployed?

pool_tokens.P: Which tokens are in the liquidity pool at {subject}?
pool_tokens.E1: Name the assets paired in the pool deployed at {subject}.
pool_tokens.E2: {subject} 주소의 유동성 풀에 들어 있는 토큰들은 무엇입니까?

vault_asset_via_symbol._hop: symbol -> vault address -> underlying asset symbol. The join is computed by the generator from two facts; neither the join nor its answer is ever a training row.
vault_asset_via_symbol.P: What is the underlying asset symbol of the vault whose share token is {subject}?
vault_asset_via_symbol.E1: Someone holds {subject}. Which token did they deposit to get it? Give the ticker.
vault_asset_via_symbol.E2: {subject} 토큰을 받으려면 어떤 토큰을 예치해야 합니까? 티커로 답하십시오.

vault_larger_tvl._hop: two TVL facts compared by the generator. {subject} is 'X or Y' — a comparison, not a lookup.
vault_larger_tvl.P: Which has more total value locked, {subject}? Answer with the symbol.
vault_larger_tvl.E1: Between {subject}, which vault is bigger by assets under management? Give its ticker only.
vault_larger_tvl.E2: {subject} 중 예치 자산이 더 많은 볼트는 무엇입니까? 티커로만 답하십시오.

vault_top_by_tvl._hop: the generator sorts the pinned-block TVL facts for the {subject} asset and takes the top 3. This is the many-entity item: arm B must read and rank a set, arm C answers from memory.
vault_top_by_tvl.P: Which three {subject} vaults have the highest total value locked? Answer with symbols only.
vault_top_by_tvl.E1: List the top 3 vaults holding {subject} by size, largest first. Tickers only.
vault_top_by_tvl.E2: {subject}를 보유한 볼트 중 예치 자산 상위 3개는 무엇입니까? 티커로만 답하십시오.

vault_fee_pct.P: What is the performance fee percentage of the ERC-4626 vault at {subject}?
vault_fee_pct.E1: What cut does the vault at {subject} take from the yield it earns? Give the percentage.

market_supply_apy.P: What is the lender supply APY of the lending market at {subject}?
market_supply_apy.E1: Someone supplies into the market at {subject}. What annual percentage rate do they earn?
market_supply_apy.E2: {subject} 대출 마켓에 공급하는 사람이 받는 연이율은 몇 퍼센트입니까?
